rejected_plans.reason: Does not optimally address customer commitment protection compared to selected plans
Resource allocation would compromise higher-priority objectives

rationale: Objective priority: plan_beta directly addresses the highest-priority goal of protecting customer commitment, followed by plan_gamma for revenue recovery and plan_alpha for ops cleanup
Resource fit: The allocation utilizes all available CPU windows (w1:4, w2:3, w3:2) without exceeding limits, ensuring efficient resource utilization
Tradeoff: This sequence sacrifices plan_delta and plan_epsilon to focus resources on the most critical objectives, accepting some opportunity cost for optimal alignment with business priorities
